definition: This dimension controls the impact of hunger or resource depletion on the player's health, abilities, or progression. It varies from mild penalties that can be easily managed to severe consequences that pose significant risks to survival and progression.
exclusion_criteria: Mechanics that do not affect player health or capabilities
inclusion_criteria: The degree of health loss associated with hunger depletion
The impact on player abilities or stats due to insufficient resources
title: Penalty Severity in Hunger Clock Mechanics
